about:
Maxzone Auto Part Corp. was established in 1997 in Fontana, California, as the North American distribution arm of DEPO, a Taiwanese automotive lighting manufacturer founded in 1978 in Lukang, Taiwan. The company operates as an ISO‑certified distributor with four strategically placed warehouses across the United States.

Maxzone distributes DEPO’s aftermarket automotive lighting products—including replacement lamps, heavy‑duty lamps, performance lamps, FOCOPO mirrors, door handles, and cooling‑system components—through its four distribution centers totaling over 720,000 square feet in Fontana (CA), West Dundee (IL), Port Reading (NJ), and Norcross (GA). The facilities support fast delivery throughout North America, backed by vehicle test‑fit protocols, scratch‑ and UV‑resistant lens coatings, and a one‑year limited warranty on select items.

The company serves the automotive aftermarket, targeting repair shops, distributors, and retailers across North America. Its product lines cover tail lamps, fog lamps, turn signals, side markers, headlamps, mirrors, and related components for passenger vehicles and heavy‑duty applications. Maxzone exhibits regularly at AAPEX, the automotive aftermarket expo, to reach industry buyers.

Maxzone’s stated mission is to satisfy customers with quality products, competitive value, and comprehensive service, guided by ethics, teamwork, and responsive customer service. Its vision is to lead the importing, warehousing, and distribution of aftermarket automotive products, leveraging DEPO’s decades of R&D and manufacturing expertise.
